Class SwerveInputStream

java.lang.Object
yams.commands3.swerve.SwerveInputStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Supplier<org.wpilib.math.kinematics.ChassisVelocities>
public class SwerveInputStream extends Object implements Supplier<org.wpilib.math.kinematics.ChassisVelocities>
Helper class to transform controller inputs into workable Chassis speeds for the Commands v3 API.

    • withTelemetry

      public SwerveInputStream withTelemetry(String name, TelemetryVerbosity verbosity)
      Publish this stream's telemetry under SwerveInputStream/<name>, updated every time the stream is read. At TelemetryVerbosity.HIGH the stream is also live tunable: see SwerveInputStreamTelemetry. Replaces any telemetry this stream already had. A clone() does not copy the telemetry.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the stream in NetworkTables (e.g., "drive").
      verbosity - TelemetryVerbosity to publish at.
      Returns:
      this, for chaining.
